punchline: Julia Cameron prescribes a weekly date with yourself where you're not supposed to produce anything at all.
thirty_sec: Julia Cameron compares creativity to a well. Every time you make something, you draw water out, and it doesn't refill on its own. Her fix is the artist date: a block of time once a week, alone, doing something that delights you. A museum, a junk shop, a walk, a concert. Nothing has to come out of it. And it's the tool people most often skip.
question: If you had a free afternoon just for your own curiosity, where would you go?
